sentences.text:
PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DIVYESH A. JOSHI  Date : 19/10/2023  ORAL ORDER 1.

The present application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for regular bail in connection with the FIR being CR No.11202008230476 of 2023 registered with the City 'A' Division Police Station, Jamnagar of the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420 read with Section 114 of the IPC and Section 3 of the Gujarat Protection of Interest of Depositors (In Financial Establishments) Act, 2003.

sentences.text: 2. Learned advocate appearing for the applicant has submitted that the applicant-accused was arrested on 07.04.2023 and since then he is in jail.
Learned advocate for the applicant has also submitted that the investigation has already been completed and the charge-sheet has also been filed.

Learned advocate for the applicant has further NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/18849/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 undefined submitted that the present applicant-accused has been involved in the present offence only on the basis of the statement of the co-accused.

sentences.text: 1 advocate for the applicant has also submitted that allegation levelled against the applicant-accused is that he was the Director of the company run and managed by the accused No.1, however, there is no evidence produced on record to show that the applicant-accused was working as a Director in the Company.

Learned advocate for the applicant has also submitted that the money was handed over to the accused No.1 and the applicant-accused has not received a single rupee either from the complainant or from any other person.
It is further submitted that the applicant-accused is an illiterate person even does not know the meaning of Company and he has been made a scapegoat by the accused No.1.
Learned advocate has also submitted that a search was carried out at the house of the applicant-accuse, but nothing incriminating was found from the house of the applicant.
Even the bank account of the applicant was also seized, but no any suspicious entry was found from the same.

Learned advocate for the applicant has further submitted that the main accused, namely,
Dineshbhai Savjibhai Rathod has already been enlarged on bail by a Coordinate Bench of this Court.
Under the circumstances, learned advocate for the applicant prays that the applicant may be enlarged on bail on any suitable terms and conditions.
3. The learned APP appearing on behalf of the respondent- State has opposed grant of regular bail looking to the nature and gravity of the offence.

Learned APP has submitted that the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/18849/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 undefined present applicant-accused has been shown as the Director of the Company who had floated various schemes to dupe the people at large.
Learned APP has further submitted that looking to the role attributed to the present applicant-accused, he may not be enlarged on bail.
4. The learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties do not press for further reasoned order.

5. I have heard the learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties and perused the papers of the investigation and considered the allegations levelled against the applicant and the role played by the applicant.

This Court has also taken into consideration the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012]1 SCC 40.
7.

sentences.text: In the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations made against the applicant in the FIR, without discussing the evidence in detail, NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/18849/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 undefined prima facie, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to exercise the discretion and enlarge the applicant on regular bail.

9. The authorities will release the applicant only if he is not NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/18849/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 undefined required in connection with any other offence for the time being.
If breach of any of the above conditions is committed, the Sessions Judge concerned will be free to issue warrant or take appropriate action in the matter.
10. Bail bond to be executed before the lower Court having jurisdiction to try the case.
It will be open for the concerned Court to delete, modify and/or relax any of the above conditions, in accordance with law.
11. At the trial, the trial Court shall not be influenced by the observations of preliminary nature qua the evidence at this stage made by this Court while enlarging the applicant on bail.
Direct service is permitted.
